name: services/courses/courses
description:
Get information on multiple courses.

This method is similar to the course method, but it works with multiple courses. It also has a limited fields support.

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector must contain subset of primary fields, which are described in the returns section of course method.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns: A dictionary: your course_ids will be mapped to dictionary's keys, and each value will contain the description of a course, as defined in the course method.
